assumptions.choice: New York session open is mapped to 14:00 local time in the +01:00 timezone feed (13:00 UTC / 08:00 EDT). The 60-minute ORB range is calculated during hour 14 (14:00-15:00).
assumptions.reason: The feed is localized at +01:00 offset, corresponding to standard 13:00 UTC New York forex session open.

assumptions.choice: Trade entries are allowed from 15:00 to 17:00 (first 3 hours of NY session elapsed).
assumptions.reason: Specification states that trades must not be generated after the first 3 hours of the New York session have elapsed.

assumptions.choice: All open positions are closed at 21:00 (+01:00 timezone).
assumptions.reason: Specification requires all trades to be closed by the end of the trading day.

assumptions.choice: A deviation occurs when price low/high breaches ORB boundary, and signal triggers when close moves back inside boundary.
assumptions.reason: Literal translation of 'drops below/rises above ORB boundary and then rises/falls back'.

assumptions.choice: Risk percentage fixed at 1% of current account value per trade.
assumptions.reason: Specification dictates fixed percentage of trading capital (e.g. 1-2%).
